info.title: Foxfleet hub API
info.description: The contract shared by the hub, the web app and the Android app. Contract tests (contract/run.mjs) run against the real hub and the web mock hub.

servers.description: Your hub; clients ask for the address on first launch

post.summary: Experimental non-displacing bot HTTP requests (default off).
post.description: Requires bot API flag. Authorization: Bot <token>; no cookie/Bearer auth, query strings, redirects or socket lease. Shared store/rate/idempotency/run behavior with WebSocket. Only send/edit/delete/typing; protocol errors are HTTP 200 res, invalid correlation ids use null. See bot-api.md and bot-http.vectors.json. Encoded body limit 1 MiB. Tested by server/test/bot-http-contract.test.js rather than the default-off web mock scenario.

post.summary: OpenAI-style chat, streamed as Server-Sent Events (text/event-stream). Events: data chunks with choices[].delta.content / reasoning_content, `hermes.tool.progress`, `foxfleet.tool` ({type: tool.start|tool.progress|tool.end, turn_id, tool_id, name}; per-call lifecycle, from native agents), `[DONE]`. Session id in X-Hermes-Session-Id, always set: for a new chat on a Hermes agent reached over HTTP the hub names the chat and sends that id to Hermes (Hermes's own id wins when it returns one), so live events and message.new carry the same chat (0.4.1).
post.description: For a native-capable Hermes agent (capabilities.nativeUi) the hub routes this to the native session server-side: same shapes, the reply is followed as a run, and extra SSE events foxfleet.request / foxfleet.request_closed / foxfleet.ack carry cards and Hermes acknowledgements.

Hand control back to the agent.

get.summary: Fetch a remote https image for Markdown through the hub (SSRF-checked: public addresses only, https:443, no SVG, 8 MB, 10 s).
Chat runs of this agent still held by the hub (running, or finished within the last 10 minutes). A run keeps going if the client disconnects.

Replays a run's events after the cursor (?after=N or Last-Event-ID) and follows it live. Events carry `id: N`; `foxfleet.gap` says older events were dropped from the bounded log; `foxfleet.run` says the run was stopped or failed.
get.description: Frames: OpenAI-style `data: {choices:[{delta:{content|reasoning_content}}]}`; `event: hermes.tool.progress` {tool} once when a tool starts (and for commentary); `event: foxfleet.tool` (RunToolFrame) for the tool lifecycle; `event: foxfleet.step` (RunStepFrame, 0.4.1) for commentary, status lines and subagents; `event: foxfleet.request` / `foxfleet.request_closed` / `foxfleet.ack` (native gateway); `event: foxfleet.gap`; `event: foxfleet.run`. Clients ignore unknown events and fields. See docs/LIVE-EVENTS.md "Step detail".

post.summary: Stop the run. Resolves once termination is confirmed (confirmed=true) or reports the truth when it is not (confirmed=false, the run keeps going). Halts queue draining.

get.summary: Slash commands for this agent. Hermes starts from the bundled registry. A connected gateway adds that profile's skills and any extra names, which stay non-executable. Pass session to scope the live catalog to that chat. Other kinds: the local chat commands.

Supports Range for video/audio.

get.summary: Account-wide notification stream (SSE).
get.description: Server-Sent Events. Resume with Last-Event-ID or ?after=<id> (digits only; anything else means no cursor). Frames: `retry: 3000`; optional `event: foxfleet.gap` {first,cursor}; `event: notify` with `id:` and an Event as data; once `event: foxfleet.ready` {contract,cursor,dropped} (no id); `: keep-alive` comment every 15 s; `event: foxfleet.auth` {reason:'signed_out'} then close when the device session ends. The response carries X-Session-Token when the app token was rotated by this request: store it. At most 8 streams per account (429).

parameters.description: Cursor; same as Last-Event-ID (this one wins).

parameters.name: reply
parameters.description: Feature `notifyReply` (0.4.0): `1` adds `reply: {token, expires_at}` to reply_finished and approval events, minted for this device stream only.

X-Session-Token.description: Present only when the app's bearer token was rotated by this request.

get.summary: Live chat events for open clients (SSE, feature `live`).
get.description: Server-Sent Events (docs/LIVE-EVENTS.md). v1 (no `v`) carries no message text; v2 carries message text in message.new / message.edited. v1: resume with Last-Event-ID or ?after=<epoch>:<n>; no cursor starts at now. Frames: `retry: 2000`; optional `event: foxfleet.gap` {cursor} (hub restarted or buffer overrun: do a full catch-up); `event: live` with `id: <epoch>:<n>` and {id,type,agent,chat,at,run_id?,state?,request_id?,kind?}, type one of run_started, run_finished, approval; once `event: foxfleet.ready` {contract:'foxfleet.live/1',cursor,heartbeat_ms} (no id); `: keep-alive` every 15 s; `event: foxfleet.auth` {reason:'signed_out'} then close. At most 8 streams per account (429). v2 (feature `live2`, 0.4.0): add ?v=2 for contract foxfleet.live/2: persistent per-account seq, `id: <store>:<seq>`, `event: <type>` with a LiveEvent body, ephemeral `event: typing` (TypingEvent, no id), ephemeral `event: run.step` (RunStepEvent, no id, 0.4.1), foxfleet.ready {contract,cursor,store,heartbeat_ms}, foxfleet.gap {reason: expired|reset|invalid, cursor} (a v1 `<epoch>:<n>` id is a `reset`). Without v the stream is v1, unchanged. Unsupported v: 400 unsupported_version.

get.summary: Provider and model choices for any agent with capabilities.models native or request (0.4.1).
get.description: Native gateway agents: the live picker (same as /native/models). Hermes API-server agents: GET /api/model/options of the agent. 409 models_unsupported when the agent has none (bots, older Hermes, other kinds). With ?session_id= a `request` agent also returns the chat's override. See docs/LIVE-EVENTS.md "Model picker".

parameters.name: refresh
parameters.description: Ask the agent to probe its providers again (slow).

post.summary: Per-chat model override for agents with capabilities.models `request` (0.4.1): kept by the hub, sent as model/provider with every new run of this chat; `model: null` clears it.
post.description: Applies from the next run (a running reply keeps its model). Native gateway agents use POST /native/sessions/{sid}/model instead (409 models_unsupported here).

provider.description: Provider slug from the same list. Without one Hermes may ignore the model on chat completions.

botToken.name: Authorization
botToken.description: Bot <token>, never Bearer; experimental bot API only

session.name: foxfleet_session
session.description: Web: HttpOnly cookie. Apps send the token from login(client=app) as `Authorization: Bearer`.

replyToken.name: X-Foxfleet-Reply-Token
replyToken.description: 0.4.0: 24 h token scoped to one device, agent and chat; only /api/notify/reply and /api/notify/read.

code.description: Machine-readable reason when the hub knows one, e.g. machine_offline, display_unsupported, gateway_unreachable, dashboard_auth, timeout, reopen (screen routes); outside, denied, missing, too_big, type, rate (media). Clients show a specific message for each and fall back to `error` for unknown codes. History (GET /api/agents/{name}/sessions/{id}/messages): agent_offline, timeout, auth_failed, upstream_error (docs/API-ERRORS.md). Phase 1 (0.4.0): unsupported_version, invalid_cursor, cursor_expired (410, body also has `cursor`), too_many_streams (429, live v1 and v2), chat_not_found, invalid_read_position, invalid_idempotency_key, idempotency_conflict (409), reply_token_invalid (403, never 401), text_too_long (413), rate_limited (429 + Retry-After). 0.4.1 (model routes): models_unsupported (409), invalid_model (400). 0.4.1 (reactions): invalid_emoji (400), invalid_message_id (400), message_not_found (404), reaction_limit (409).

acceptedTerms.description: Terms version this user accepted at sign-up, if recorded.

termsVersion.description: Current version label of the Terms of Use and Privacy Policy.

hub.description: What this hub is (0.3.5+). Absent on older hubs: clients treat that as 'hub needs an update' and say so.

acceptedTerms.description: Version label of the Terms of Use and Privacy Policy the person accepted (see termsVersion in GET /api/auth). Optional for older clients; the hub records version and time.
Version label of the Terms of Use and Privacy Policy the person accepted (see termsVersion in GET /api/auth). Optional for older clients; the hub records version and time.

busy.description: Send modes this agent supports while it is replying

nativeRuns.description: Hermes advertises native run controls (run_submission, run_events_sse, run_steer, run_stop)

nativeUi.description: The machine connector can drive a native Hermes UI gateway for this profile (preferred over /v1/runs and chat completions)

media.description: Who can deliver this agent's pictures, videos and files (0.3.5+). Shown as the Media row of the agent's test. Never contains paths or addresses.

local.description: The agent runs on a paired machine (files come from its disk through the connector)

version.description: null = a connector older than 0.3.5 that does not report one

toolMedia.description: Pictures and files made by tools (not only MEDIA: lines) become cards (native Hermes)

reactions.description: The hub keeps emoji reactions for this agent's conversations.

agentReactions.description: The agent can react itself (Hermes: a REACT: line in its reply).

models.description: How a client changes the model (0.4.1): `native` through the native gateway (GET /native/models, POST /native/sessions/{sid}/model); `request` through GET /api/agents/{name}/models and a per-chat override (POST /api/agents/{name}/sessions/{id}/model) the hub sends with each new run of that chat; `none`: no model list (bots, older Hermes, other kinds). Hide the picker for `none`.

last_activity_at.description: Unix ms of the last message sent to or received from this agent by THIS user (null: none yet). The agents list is returned sorted: pinned first (pin_order), then newest activity.

last_session_title.description: Title of the chat that was last active, when the hub knows it

last_message_preview.description: One plain line (no Markdown, no MEDIA: tags, secrets or addresses removed; a picture-only reply reads Photo, Video, Voice message or File: name)

pin_order.description: 0-based, in the order the user pinned

working.description: A reply is running for this user right now

needs_input.description: An approval or clarification request is open (native Hermes)

stale.description: true: the live probe of this agent did not finish in time for this response, so the status fields (online, chatReady, managementReady, checks, ...) are the last known result from checked_at. A fresh probe is still running; the next poll picks it up. See docs/API-ERRORS.md.

checked_at.description: Unix ms when the status fields were last probed. Results are reused for about 10 s.

Connection.description: Plain fields plus hasX flags for write-only ones. Never carries secrets or addresses.

ack.description: What Hermes itself answered (native sessions). Shown as received, never predicted; null until it answered.

halted.description: Automatic draining is paused (after Stop or a hub restart) until resume or a new message

open_requests.description: Native sessions: cards that are still open, so a reload or a second device shows them again

can_cancel.description: False when the agent keeps the queue itself (Hermes): DELETE /queue/{id} answers 409

ack.description: What Hermes answered: streaming, queued, steered, redirected, rejected or reconciled. Never predicted.

OpenRequest.description: A question or approval the agent waits on. Answer once with POST /api/agents/{name}/native/sessions/{sid}/requests/{rid}. Other request kinds are declined upstream and never listed.

id.description: user:<account> or agent:<name>; bound by the hub from the credential, never taken from a request body.

messages.description: Stable message id -> reactions on it, including reactions agents wrote as a REACT: line.

hidden.description: Ids of messages this account hid (delete for me). Absent on hubs before 0.3.9. Since 0.4.1 a message hidden by hub id is listed here once its upstream id is known.

by_hub_id.description: 0.4.1 (feature `reactionEvents`): the same reactions keyed by the hub's stable message id (`hub_id`, live v2 and history), for every message the hub has numbered, including messages that have no upstream id yet. A GET leaves out messages with no reactions; a PUT/DELETE answer always lists the message it targeted, as [] once it has none (also under `messages` when its upstream id is known).

changed.description: 0.4.1, PUT/DELETE only: false when the reaction was already there (PUT) or already gone (DELETE); no `message.reaction` is sent then. The snapshot in the answer is current either way.

hidden_hub_ids.description: 0.4.1: every hidden message by hub_id, including messages with no upstream id yet.

upstream_id.description: The agent's own message id once known (reactions/hide use it).

reasoning.description: 0.4.1, assistant messages: the reply's reasoning (at most 64 KiB UTF-8). Absent when none.

tools.description: 0.4.1, assistant messages: tools the reply ran, same shape as history ({name, args?, result?, ok?}); args and result at most 500 characters + …. Absent when none.

reactions.description: 0.4.1 (feature `reactionEvents`): the message's current reactions, only when it has any. Live updates come as `message.reaction`.

react.description: 0.4.1, assistant messages: the emoji the reply's `REACT:` line applied to the user's message.

reaction_only.description: 0.4.1, assistant messages: true when the reply shows nothing besides its `REACT:` line (apps draw no row; it is not unread and not the chat-list preview).

hub_id.description: null only when the preview comes from the agent's own session list before the hub numbered any message of this agent

sender.description: `you` for the user, else the agent label

preview.description: Plain text, markup and tool output removed; media as a short label (Photo, Video, File: name)

agent_unread.description: over all sessions of the agent

total_unread.description: badge: rows neither muted nor archived

LiveEvent.description: v2 event (docs/LIVE-EVENTS.md). Clients ignore unknown types and fields.

type.description: message.new, message.edited, message.deleted, message.status, read, chat.updated, chat.removed, run.started, run.finished, approval, message.reaction (0.4.1) (open set)

upstream_id.description: message.reaction: the agent's id of that message; left out (not null) while unknown.

reactions.description: message.reaction: the full current set on that message after the change ([] when none). Replace, do not merge.

TypingEvent.description: Ephemeral `event: typing` frame on the v2 stream: no id, no seq, never replayed.

label.description: 0.4.1: what the step is about (tool arguments preview, commentary or a status line). Absent when unknown.

tool_id.description: 0.4.1: the running tool call (state `tool`), same id as on run.step and foxfleet.tool. Absent when unknown.

RunStepEvent.description: 0.4.1: ephemeral `event: run.step` frame on the v2 stream (like typing: no id, no seq, never stored or replayed, not on the pull endpoint). One per tool start/end, commentary or status line of a running reply. A client that missed some just shows the next one; the finished message.new carries the summary (reasoning, tools).

preview.description: tool.start: arguments preview (at most 200 characters + …); tool.end: result preview (at most 500 + …)

duration_ms.description: tool.end, when the agent reports it

text.description: commentary / status: the line to show

RunToolFrame.description: `event: foxfleet.tool` on a run stream (/runs/{id}/events, /chat, /messages). Native gateway agents since 0.3.x; Hermes /v1/runs agents since 0.4.1. The 0.4.1 fields are additive.

tool_id.description: the agent's call id, or t1, t2 … per run when the agent sends none (empty on a tool.progress the hub cannot pair)

preview.description: tool.start (0.4.1): one-line arguments preview, at most 200 characters + …

result_preview.description: tool.end (0.4.1): at most 500 characters + …; never the full result

RunStepFrame.description: 0.4.1: `event: foxfleet.step` on a run stream: something the agent says or reports between tool calls.

override.description: `request` agents with ?session_id=: the chat's override, absent when none
